name: @modelcontextprotocol/server-basic-raw
description: Zero-dependency MCP App example using raw JSON-RPC over stdio/HTTP and postMessage

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && bun build main.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target node --banner "#!/usr/bin/env node"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.start:stdio: npm run build 1>&2 && npm run serve:stdio
